company.what_they_do: General Packaging Corporation is a Texas-based custom manufacturer of packaging products. Their core offerings are: (1) corrugated boxes and custom corrugated packaging in single, double, and triple wall fiberboard with printing capabilities; (2) wood products — pallets, skids, crates, and other industrial wood items; (3) custom foam inserts and assemblies for product protection; and (4) engineered/integrated packaging solutions designed by an in-house engineering team. They serve hundreds of customers monthly across diverse industries. They also offer an ISTA-certified package testing lab, CAD design capabilities, and product warehousing. Positioning emphasizes custom/engineered solutions over commodity boxes, competitive pricing, and customer service. They are family-owned and operated.
raw_notes: Founded 1957; incorporated 8/25/1960; BBB accredited since 2006 — nearly 70 years in business.

Family-owned and operated; leadership names from BBB: James W. Brown III (President), James Brown IV (Executive Vice President), Bradley E. Brown (Director) — the 'Brown' family appears to run the company across generations.
Headquartered at 200 E Arapaho Rd, Richardson, TX 75081 (corporate offices + plant, ~14 miles north of Dallas).

Four production plants across Texas per their About page (as of March 2025): Richardson (corrugated + HQ), Dallas/Fair Park (wood products, operating since 1981), Conroe/north Houston (industrial packaging, oil & gas / heavy industry / export focus), and a fourth (Garland address appears on BBB — 2755 Miller Park N Ste 100, Garland, TX 75042).
RocketReach estimates ~59 employees and ~$36M revenue (third-party estimate, unverified).
LinkedIn lists company size as 51–200 employees, privately held.
CAD capabilities: Mechanical Desktop, AutoCAD, ArtiosCAD.
Manufacturing capabilities: slitting, die-cutting, laminating, two-color printing, gluing, stitching.
Sustainability focus: recycled fiber sourcing, recyclable products (corrugated, foam, wood), sells wood waste back to sawmills/farmers.
Conroe plant has special focus on oil & gas, heavy industry, and export packaging.
Dallas plant specializes in new construction wood pallets, crates, bed frame foundations.

Featured project examples on homepage: custom corrugated inserts for lighting components, adjustable wood/foam motor shipping crate with latches, branded retail-ready box with high-quality print, heavy-duty double-wall corrugated alternative to plywood crate with integrated foam and built-in loading ramp.
USDOT carrier record exists (USDOT #1266901) — they operate their own fleet (8 drivers, 9 power units).
Market positioning tagline: 'Anyone can give you a box. We provide you with the right packaging solution at extremely competitive prices.'
